testcase.name: Scenario: Launch document settings from a width-compacted ribbon panel: tmp/oblikovati-ribbon-relocated.RcZVDl/display-snapshot/checkout/features/application/ribbon-display/ribbon-display.feature:391:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Launch document settings from a width-compacted ribbon panel ✔ Given a part is active in the MCAD Software with the full Tools ribbon displayed ✔ And the narrow window shows Options as a compact panel button ✔ When the user opens the Options panel ✔ And the user selects Document Settings ✔ Then the Document Settings dialog opens for the active part ✔ When the user closes the dialog without changing settings ✔ Then the dialog and temporary Options panel are closed ✔ And the Tools ribbon and part remain visible
